extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, PTAB stakeholders, policymakers, and analysts tracking PTAB trial outcomes
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of metrics and reporting rules from the Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) Fiscal Year 2022 outcome roundup covering IPR and PGR petitions, institution rates, settlements, outcomes, and aggregate patent-level statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by trial type
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts and percentages of petitions filed by trial type during the fiscal year (IPR vs PGR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FY22: IPR 1,320 (97%), PGR 47 (3%), Total 1,367. Trial types include Inter Partes Review (IPR) and Post Grant Review (PGR). Timeframe: FY22 (Oct. 1, 2021 to Sept. 30, 2022).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of petitions filed by technology category with counts and percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FY22 categories and counts: Electrical/Computer 892 (65%), Mechanical & Business Method 319 (23%), Bio/Pharma 95 (7%), Chemical 55 (4%), Design 6 (0%). Total 1,367. Use these technology buckets for technology-specific analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions filed by month
rubrics_metrics.description: Monthly counts of petitions filed (separately for IPR and PGR) over a 12-month window.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for Sept 1, 2021 to Sept 30, 2022 (example monthly counts shown for each month for IPR and PGR). FY22 totals: 1,320 IPRs and 47 PGRs; monthly trends are displayed to show seasonality or spikes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate (by petition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of petitions instituted (versus denied) calculated on a per-petition basis for a given timeframe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time series FY18–FY22 presented with percentages and counts of instituted vs denied by petition. Charts show institution percentages by fiscal year (e.g., annual instituted/denied counts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate (by patent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of patents instituted (versus denied) calculated on a per-patent basis for a given timeframe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Time series FY18–FY22 presented with percentages and counts of instituted vs denied by patent. Institution-by-patent can differ from institution-by-petition; both are reported for context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rates: patent vs petition comparison
rubrics_metrics.description: Side-by-side comparison of institution rates calculated by patent and by petition across years to show differences between the two bases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FY18–FY22 shown together (e.g., by patent 70%/67%/... and by petition 63%/60%/...). Use both measures to understand institution dynamics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution rate by technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Institution rate calculated for each technology category (percentage of petitions instituted among decisions on institution for that technology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FY22 example rates: Bio/Pharma 77% (72 of 94), Chemical 48% (29 of 60), Design 33% (1 of 3), Electrical/Computer 68% (497 of 733), Mechanical & Business Method 66% (170 of 259). Calculation note: Institution rate for each technology is calculated by dividing petitions instituted by decisions on institution (i.e., petitions instituted plus petitions denied). The outcomes of decisions on institution responsive to requests for rehearing are excluded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement rate and settlement counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Settlement rate for proceedings and counts of settlements (pre-institution and post-institution) by fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement rate is calculated by dividing total settlements by concluded proceedings in each fiscal year (i.e., denied institution, settled, dismissed, requested adverse judgment, and final written decision), excluding joined cases. FY18–FY22 settlement counts and rates are reported, with distinction between pre-institution and post-institution settlements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by petition (FWD-level outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final Written Decision (FWD) outcomes reported at the petition level indicating patentability or unpatentability with respect to the claims at issue; joined cases excluded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FWD patentability or unpatentability reported with respect to the claims at issue in the FWD. Joined cases are excluded from these counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by patent (FWD and other outcomes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification of patents by outcome (FWD categories and other end-of-proceeding outcomes), including a 'Mixed Outcome' category for patents receiving more than one type of outcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ‘Mixed Outcome’ is shown for patents receiving more than one type of outcome from the list of: denied, settled, dismissed, and/or requested adverse judgement only. A patent is listed in a FWD category if it ever received a FWD, regardless of other outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes by claim challenged
rubrics_metrics.description: Claim-level outcome statistics for challenged claims within proceedings (e.g., whether claims were found unpatentable, patentable, or not decided).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claim-level outcomes are reported (counts by outcome category) for FY22; joined cases and the specifics of claim-level treatment follow the same exclusion rules where noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim outcome labels: 'No DI' and 'No FWD'
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions for special claim outcome labels indicating claims were challenged but not addressed in a Decision on Institution (DI) or Final Written Decision (FWD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ‘No DI’ and ‘No FWD’ means the claim was challenged but not addressed in a DI/FWD, e.g., due to settlement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion of joined cases
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting rule that joined cases are excluded from certain counts and rates presented in the report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement rate and several outcome metrics explicitly exclude joined cases. The report repeatedly notes that joined cases are excluded from FWD and some outcome tallies.

rubrics_metrics.name: All patents: Fiscal Year 2022 aggregate metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level FY22 aggregates about the patent population and AIA proceedings that ended in FY22: live patents, patents with proceedings ending, patents partially/fully invalidated by PTAB, and percentages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported figures: ~3,780,000 live patents; 1,083 patents with AIA proceedings that ended in FY22; 350 patents at least partially invalidated by PTAB; 132 patents fully invalidated by PTAB. Additional computed percentages: 12% of patents with proceedings ending in FY22 were fully invalidated by PTAB (132 of 1,083). Less than 0.004% of all live patents in FY22 were fully invalidated by PTAB (132 of ~3,780,000). Events that end an AIA proceeding include denials of institution, settlements, dismissals, requests for adverse judgment, and final written decisions (FWD).

rubrics_metrics.name: All patents: All-time aggregate metrics (Sept. 16, 2012 to Sept. 30, 2022)
rubrics_metrics.description: Cumulative counts since AIA implementation through the report end date: patents challenged, partially invalidated, fully invalidated, and percent fully invalidated among challenged patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported figures: 8,578 patents challenged in AIA proceedings; 2,749 patents at least partially invalidated by PTAB; 890 patents fully invalidated by PTAB. Computed: 10% of challenged patents were fully invalidated by PTAB (890 of 8,578).

rubrics_metrics.name: FWD definition and use
rubrics_metrics.description: Interpretive rule that Final Written Decision (FWD) reports patentability/unpatentability with respect to the claims at issue and is used to categorize outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FWD patentability or unpatentability is reported with respect to the claims at issue in the FWD. A patent is listed in a FWD category if it ever received a FWD, regardless of other outcomes. Joined cases are excluded from some FWD tallies.
